summary.text: Art Stresing is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 18, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Kim Kendall.
An attorney, Stresing won the August 18 Democratic primary over Heather Anne Smith, 59.9% to 40.1%.

paragraphs.text: Stresing graduated from Notre Dame High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University at Buffalo in 2006 and a law degree from Florida Coastal School of Law in 2010, according to Ballotpedia.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he played football at Buffalo as a walk-on, has practiced law since 2011, and is a Division Chief at the Public Defender's Office in Jacksonville.

He said he was president of the Jacksonville Asian-American Bar Association for many years, has lived in the Saint Johns and Jacksonville area for 20 years, and is married to an active-duty member of the U.S. Navy.
His stated priorities were education funding, health care, affordability and services for veterans.
